name: Media Player Addons for Elementor – audio and video players made easy
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Drag, drop, and publish beautiful audio and video players in Elementor – playlists, live streams, YouTube, Vimeo, and self-hosted media, all without code.

Media Player Addons for Elementor | Pricing | Support | Demo

Why Media Player Addons for Elementor?

Most media solutions force you into complex setups, third-party dashboards, or custom code just to play audio or video. Media Player Addons for Elementor adds 15 advanced media player widgets directly inside Elementor – drag, drop, and publish in minutes. No learning curve, no technical hassle, and no recurring platform fees.

The plugin supports popular formats (.mp3, .mp4, .flv, .ogg, .webm), live streaming (HLS, DASH), playlists, picture-in-picture video, and multiple caption tracks. Whether you’re building a media-rich blog, music site, podcast page, or video gallery, every player is responsive and fully customizable.

Best of all, it’s WordPress-native: your media stays on your site, under your domain, with your rules – no third-party ecosystem locking in your content, analytics, or branding.

Available Widgets

  • HTML5 Audio Player – A lightweight custom audio player for MP3 and web audio with full styling control.
  • HTML5 Video Player – Play local or hosted MP4/WebM videos with customizable controls and responsive design.
  • YouTube Video Player – Embed YouTube videos with enhanced controls, branding options, and distraction-free playback.
  • Vimeo Video Player – Display Vimeo videos with customizable layouts and a premium-style viewing experience.
  • Art Video Player – A stylish cinematic player designed for creative video showcases and visual storytelling.
  • dPlayer Video Player – A modern, feature-packed video player with subtitles, thumbnails, hotkeys, and playback controls.
  • Advanced Audio Player – High-end audio playback with waveform visualizer, album art, track metadata, and custom branding.
  • Advanced Video Player – Professional video player supporting captions, overlays, call-to-actions, highlights, and more.
  • Advanced Audio Playlist – Build interactive audio playlists with track info, filters, and responsive layouts.
  • Advanced Video Playlist – Create organized video playlists ideal for courses, tutorials, and series content.
  • Audio Playlist Player – Simple, clean playlist player for multiple audio tracks with smooth navigation.

Free Features

  • Fully Customizable: Make each player look exactly how you want.
  • All in One: Includes popular media player libraries such as Plyr.io, cPlayer, and VideoJS.
  • Live Streaming: Supports HLS, DASH, HTTP Live Streaming, and .m3u8/.mpd video playback.
  • Playlists: Create audio and video playlists and embed them anywhere Elementor is supported.
  • Wide Format Support: Play .mp3, .mp4, .AVI, .mov, .ogg, .webM, .m3u8, .m3u, and more – playlists support combined formats.
  • Picture-in-Picture: PiP mode for videos, with plays-inline support.
  • Multiple Captions: Support for multiple caption/subtitle tracks to increase accessibility.
  • Responsive & Mobile-Optimized: Every player rescales to preserve the look and feel on all devices.
  • Translation Ready: POT files are included for translating with your WordPress language setup.
  • Maximum Options: Every player option is well documented and labeled for easy management.

Pro Version

Unlock additional playlist widgets with Media Player Addons for Elementor Pro:

  • Classic Audio Playlist – Traditional playlist layout for audio files with familiar browser-style controls.
  • Classic Video Playlist – Traditional playlist layout for video files with familiar browser-style controls.
  • Modern Audio Playlist – Modern playlist layout for audio files.
  • Card Audio Playlist – Card playlist layout for audio files.

How to Use

  1. Make sure Elementor is installed and active.
  2. Install and activate Media Player Addons for Elementor.
  3. Open a page in the Elementor editor.
  4. Drag any media player widget onto your page.
  5. Upload your audio/video file or paste a link, customize the settings, and publish.

Use Cases

  • Music Sites & Podcasts: Present tracks and episodes with playlists, album art, and waveforms.
  • Course Creators: Organize lesson videos into structured playlists.
  • Media Blogs & Video Galleries: Mix YouTube, Vimeo, and self-hosted video on one site.
  • Live Broadcasters: Stream with HLS/DASH directly on your own domain.

External services

This plugin uses external third-party services to render and display documents inside embedded viewers and iframes.

WordPress.org API

This plugin connects to the WordPress.org API (https://api.wordpress.org/plugins/info/1.2/) to retrieve a list of plugins published by the same author.

  • Purpose: To display other plugins by the author inside the admin dashboard.

  • Data Sent: No personal user data is sent. Only the author query parameter is used.

Privacy Policy: https://wordpress.org/about/privacy/
sections.installation:
Note: This plugin works with Elementor. Make sure you have Elementor installed.

From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Log in to your WordPress Administration Panel.
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New.
  3. Search for “Media Player Addons For Elementor”.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  5. Open any page with Elementor and drag a media player widget onto it.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the plugin’s .zip file to your computer.
  2. In your admin area, go to Plugins → Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the plugin’s .zip file and click Install Now.
  4. After the installation is complete, click Activate Plugin.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Media Player Addons works as an extension to Elementor, so Elementor must be installed and active.

Does it work with Elementor Free or do I need Elementor Pro?

The plugin works with the free version of Elementor. Elementor Pro is optional.

Which media formats are supported?

All popular formats, including .mp3, .mp4, .AVI, .mov, .ogg, .webM, .m3u8, and .m3u. Playlists can even combine different file formats.

Does it support live streaming?

Yes. The players support HLS, DASH, and HTTP Live Streaming, including .m3u8 and .mpd playback.

Does it support subtitles and captions?

Yes. Multiple caption/subtitle tracks are supported, which increases the accessibility of your content.

Will my audio and video files remain hosted on my own website?

Yes. Your media stays on your domain and is not sent to third-party platforms unless you embed YouTube, Vimeo, or similar services.

Does it support YouTube, Vimeo, and self-hosted media at the same time?

Yes. The plugin supports a mix of hosted media, third-party streaming, and playlist combinations.

Does it work on mobile and tablets?

Yes. All players are responsive and scale automatically for mobile devices.

Does the plugin slow down my website?

No. Players load only when used on the page and are optimized for performance.

Why won’t autoplay work in my browser?

Modern browsers block autoplay depending on sound settings and user behavior. Muted autoplay works more consistently.

Where can I get support?

Our support team is always ready to help! Visit: https://bplugins.com/support/
